short_description: Consumer-facing lifestyle trait that reports a cautious panel-relative signal for measured physical-activity tendency within the current local reference panel.
summary_note: Usable consumer-facing activity trait describing a cautious inherited signal related to measured overall physical activity relative to the current local reference panel.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with the source score for measured physical activity, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel.
interpretation_template: This is a cautious panel-relative activity signal, not a direct readout of how active you are right now. {interpretation}
caution_text: Use as a cautious panel-relative signal only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used, and the output should not be treated as a direct readout of current activity level, fitness, training load, or health status.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.
Real-world physical activity depends strongly on health, injury, work, transport habits, season, environment, and motivation.
Even when the source phenotype was measured in research, this output is still only a cautious panel-relative inherited signal.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about the real-world trait.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from raw-array files in this project; they are panel-relative, not population-wide.
